name: elysium-testnet-drops
_why: Cloak v2's own NFT drop contracts (Nov 12). Before this, v2's testnet record used Cloak v1's drop contracts (v1's config 0x9Fdf…167F, metadata on v1's domain).
_config: v2's testnet CloakConfig: drop fees go to its treasury, the testnet main wallet.
_deployer: The testnet main wallet. It gets no role: none of the three contracts has an owner.
